sentences: I measure the interior length of the container from the left door to the back wall.
I check the rubber door gaskets for cracks before sealing the container.
I record the container's identification number on the shipping manifest before departure.
I inspect the corner castings for cracks after the crane lifts the box.
I verify the twist locks are engaged on all four corners of the flatbed.
I sweep the wooden floor to remove loose debris before loading cargo.
I note the tare weight printed on the door and compare it to the scale reading.
I test the ventilation slots for blockage near the top rail of the container.
I apply rust inhibitor to the bottom rails where paint has chipped.
I photograph the cargo securing points inside the container before each departure.
I close the right door first, then the left door, and latch the handles.
I apply a bolt seal to the door hasp and write the number on the form.
I check the refrigeration unit's temperature setting for the reefer container daily.
I replace a damaged rubber gasket along the bottom edge of the door.
I stack empty containers four high in the yard using the reach stacker.
I measure the gap between the container and the chassis locking pins.
I inspect the ceiling for condensation drips inside the container each morning.
I mark the container's next inspection date on the side panel with chalk.
I load pallets into the container and brace them against the side walls.
I check the customs seal matches the number on the bill of lading.
